items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...remember Nat Cole came down one time? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, Nat Cole, Woody Herman -- remember Woody Herman and his small group?

ctx.x: Some beautiful days, man. I tell you. I really enjoyed my association with him and seeing so many artists down there; remember Nat Cole came down one time?
Yeah, Nat Cole, Woody Herman -- remember Woody Herman and his small group?
Yeah. With Shelly Manne, Ernie Royal, Milt Jackson.

items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: He even did that great song for Nat King Cole, which he did in California

ctx.x: should have brought that thing -- I got a thing at home that I can bring with a whole list of names on that.
Oh, yeah, for Clyde Otis -- like "What a Difference a Day Makes" for Dinah. He even did that great song for Nat King Cole, which he did in California -- I can't -- was it "I Can't Stop Loving You"?
No, it was a country and western song.
